name: MTAC 277 125 (MTAC, 125 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".465". No method mark: method not stated. Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 3, MTAC - Match, Tactical: Caliber .277, Grains 125, Minimum Required Twist *1-10", Part Number MTAC 277 125, G1 BC .465, OAL 1.223", Bullet Projection .655"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1 inch is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: .655".
